## Description

Tokens issued at check-in (prefix per doctor/room, e.g. A-07). TV route /queue/tv?display=… authenticated by a device display token (no user login) shows "Now: token · room · doctor" and "Next: token · ≈ wait". Large type, high contrast, auto-refresh via SignalR, works on a basic smart-TV browser.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The TV payload contains tokens, rooms, doctor display names and waits only; no patient names, MRNs or reasons (API contract test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Display tokens are revocable and scoped to one facility.
- [ ] **AC3.** Calling a patient updates the TV within 2 seconds and optionally plays a chime.
- [ ] **AC4.** Layout is readable at 3 metres (minimum 48px token text) and in Arabic/English.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
